public_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include dashboard construction in the cleanup scope**

If a chart creation, chart association, or the final dashboard save fails inside `build_dashboard()`, execution never enters this `try`, so the cleanup block is skipped. That function creates the remote dashboard before adding charts, and `DashboardCharts.add_chart()` persists each chart immediately, leaving the dashboard and any successfully created charts behind after a partial failure. Track created objects as construction proceeds and ensure cleanup also runs when construction fails.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
